nl: Add the line `198.51.100.30 queue.internal.example.com queue` to etc/hosts after the database entry.

etc/hosts.text:
127.0.0.1 localhost
::1 localhost ip6-localhost
203.0.113.5 db.internal.example.com db
198.51.100.30 queue.internal.example.com queue

oracle_program:
edit "etc/hosts" changes: [{replace: "db.internal.example.com db
", with: "db.internal.example.com db
198.51.100.30 queue.internal.example.com queue
"}]
reference_bash:
python3 - <<'EOF'
import pathlib
p = pathlib.Path('etc/hosts'); t = p.read_text()
assert t.count('db.internal.example.com db\n') == 1
p.write_text(t.replace('db.internal.example.com db\n', 'db.internal.example.com db\n198.51.100.30 queue.internal.example.com queue\n'))
EOF
